HomePage.seoTitle: OBD Diagnostic Devices for All Brands
HomePage.seoDescription: GlobeGuard – professional vehicle diagnostics from Switzerland. BASIC and PRO for private users, ELITE multibrand devices for workshops. Cars, motorcycles, trucks, buses and trailers.

hero.subtitle: Professional diagnostic devices with workshop-grade functionality for cars, motorcycles, campers, trucks, and commercial vehicles.

b2c.title: Your diagnostic device in three steps
b2c.subtitle: Choose your vehicle type, choose your brand, check the model year – done.
b2c.basicText: Diagnostics for 1 brand group from model year 2008. The cost-effective solution for owners of one vehicle – also available as a WoMo version with Truma support.
b2c.womoText: 1 brand group + Truma diagnostics. Car/van + Truma add-on equipment – for camper and motorhome travellers.
b2c.proText: Workshop-level diagnostics from model year 1991 – up to 3 brand groups on one device, expandable via PRO Erweiterung. Also for trucks, buses, trailers, agriculture and industry.

b2b.title: GlobeGuard ELITE – Multibrand Without Compromise
b2b.subtitle: All brand groups of a vehicle class on one device – from the ELITE Cars Mixed (4–10 brand groups) to the ELITE Full covering all classes.

benefits.title: Your benefits
benefits.sgwText: Security Gateway access for Fiat, Mercedes-Benz and the VW Group – bypass cables and licenses available directly from us.
benefits.coverageText: From cars and motorcycles to trucks, buses and trailers – workshop-level diagnostics for over 75 brand groups.
benefits.shippingChText: Fast shipping to Switzerland and Liechtenstein directly from Cham – free shipping and no customs fees, no surprises, support in German and English.
benefits.shippingDeText: Fast shipping to the EU and worldwide directly from Germany. Please note: deliveries outside the EU may be subject to customs and country-specific fees.
benefits.updatesText: Software updates for every device and a remote diagnostics service when you need support – your device stays up to date.
